name: durable-spec-states-what-is
body:
A durable spec states what is. R1–R5 are the spec rules every APG instance applies to its durable tier 1–3 nodes, their notes, and their constraints. The rules govern the whole distributed agent suite APG ships — `opencode-suite/agents/*.md`, embedded into the `apg` binary via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`.

R1 — Positive definition. A tier-1–3 node states a positive, affirmative definition of what is, in the present tense.

R2 — Constraint scope. A constraint's layer is its scope: a `global.constraint.*` binds the whole durable spec for every APG instance, and a `<tier>.constraint.*` (requirements/domain/solution/implementation) binds that tier. A constraint declares its scope through its layer. The law is `global.constraint.spec-constraint-scope`.

R3 — One note per node. A node has at most one note, and that note deepens the node's definition of what is.

R4 — A note details exactly one node. A note's `details` edge names exactly one node.

R5 — Timeless truth. A spec node states timeless truth: the reality it defines.

WRITER RULES — `spec-writer`, `plan-writer`, `codebase-navigator`:
- R1: author a positive, present-tense definition of what is.
- R2: place a negative rule in a constraint whose layer is its scope — global or a tier.
- R3/R4: give a node at most one note, deepening what is; a note details exactly one node.
- R5: author timeless truth.
- Run `apg spec lint` before hand-off and heed its warnings.

REVIEWER RULES — `spec-review`, `plan-review`, `implementation-phase-reviewer`:
- Run `apg spec lint` deterministically first and treat its errors as blocking.
- Judge every spec node under review semantically against R1–R5: positive/affirmative and present-tense (R1); a negative rule in a layer-scoped constraint (R2); at most one note, deepening (R3); a note detailing exactly one node (R4); timeless content (R5).
- The fix is to delete or rewrite the offending content to what is.

ACCEPTANCE (prompt-only; assessed by review of the edited prompt files):
- `opencode-suite/agents/spec-writer.md`, `plan-writer.md`, and `codebase-navigator.md` state R1–R5 and the writer rules above.
- `opencode-suite/agents/spec-review.md`, `plan-review.md`, and `implementation-phase-reviewer.md` state the deterministic `apg spec lint` step and the semantic R1–R5 review, with delete/rewrite as the fix.
- The suite's `note` node type deepens the understanding of what is.
